issue: name is not null-checked before calling toUpperCase().
suggested_fix: Guard with Objects.requireNonNull(name) or check name != null first.

issue: The loop condition i <= values.length reads one index past the end of the array.
suggested_fix: Change the bound to i < values.length.

issue: conn.close() can throw SQLException, which is not handled or declared.
suggested_fix: Wrap in a try/catch and log the exception, or declare it thrown.
